name: Falken's Maze
summary: A maze hidden in fog: you see only the cells you have stood on and where their passages lead. Every six moves WOPR moves a wall you have not seen yet, to make your way out longer.
howToPlay: Walk the @ from START at the top left to the [] EXIT at the bottom right. The maze is 19 cells wide and 5 cells high.
Each key press moves one cell. A wall stops you, and bumping into one does not count as a move.
Cells you have not seen show as a dim dot. Walls you have seen never change, and the exit can always be reached.
Every 6 moves WOPR moves a wall you have not seen, at most 12 times a game. The bottom of the frame counts your MOVES, YOUR TURNS at junctions (LEFT, STRAIGHT, RIGHT) and WALLS MOVED.
Press Q to give up. WOPR tells you how many moves away the exit was.

controls.does: move one cell up, down, left or right
move up, left, down or right (either case)
move left, down, up or right (lower case only)
give up; WOPR says how far away the exit was
leave the game and go back to WOPR

tips: Keep one hand on the wall: always take the left-most way (or always the right-most). The maze never has loops, even after WOPR moves a wall, so following one wall always gets you out.
Walls only move where you have not looked. Every cell you have seen keeps its walls, so a dead end you have found stays a dead end, and only the fog needs searching.
WOPR moves at most 12 walls, one every 6 moves. After 72 moves the maze stops changing, so a slow, careful search still finds the exit.
WOPR closes passages where the way on is your favourite turn at a junction. Mix up your left and right turns.

screenshots.caption: The start: everything is fog except your first cell. The @ stands at START and the [] marks the EXIT at the bottom right.
Move 50: WOPR has moved 8 walls and says YOU FAVOUR RIGHT TURNS, PROFESSOR. SO NOTED.
Out: ESCAPED, drawn in the maze's own walls, then YOU FOUND THE EXIT IN 52 MOVES. WOPR MOVED 8 WALLS.
